statements.quote: While TeraWulf historically operated bitcoin mining facilities and leveraged flexible compute loads to support early infrastructure development, going forward the Company’s capital allocation, development activities, and operating focus are centered on HPC data center development, long-term hosting arrangements, and infrastructure supporting AI-driven compute workloads.
statements.notes: Says 'capital allocation', not 'capital expenditures', and links it to HPC data centers and AI-driven compute infrastructure together rather than to AI alone. 'Going forward' is forward-looking but names no year. p02 describes the same capital shift toward HPC data center development but does not mention AI, so it is not recorded.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes research and development, infrastructure, or headcount operating expenses to AI
